lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular spots in approximately vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin; the most prominent column displays five distinct nodes with equidistant vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular spots, creating a visible grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal features are visible across the flank, each defined by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct yellow-pigmented pixel cluster, representing a commensal organism, is located immediately dorsal to the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
